name: Very Defensive
desc: A very deep block, minimum risk. To protect narrow leads or in heavily outmatched games.

name: Defensive
desc: Prioritises solidity and cautious transitions. The away underdog.

name: Cautious
desc: Balanced but prudent; slower, more patient possession.

name: Balanced
desc: A neutral starting point; instructions and roles define the character.

name: Positive
desc: Proactive without extremes: pushes lines up, more controlled risk. A great default for favourites.

name: Attacking
desc: More width, tempo and risk. Watch your rest-defence.

name: Very Attacking
desc: All-out attack. Use it late on when you need goals; it leaves transitions very exposed.
